'''Falloon''', who was really the former [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] accountant '''Soolehad''', was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]]<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Falloon offered a group a large amount of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to help him rescue his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[9T-LOM]] from six [[Human/Legends|Human]] members of the [[Peace Brigade]] before the imminent [[Invasion of Sriluur|invasion]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. The group managed to get him and his droid past the thugs, as well as a group of [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] [[Chazrach]] soldiers and Yuuzhan Vong [[Warrior caste|warriors]] and to his [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian]] [[FX-77 Star Yacht]] ''[[Gilded Thranta]]''. The droid contained hundreds of years worth of financial data on Black Sun which Sollehad intended to deliver to associates on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] before he retired,<ref name="LCaL" /> after which he gave the group his ship.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
